verdict.rationale: CockroachDB Cloud's Basic/Serverless offering documents usage-based Request Unit consumption that 'scales to zero when your cluster has no activity', which shows automatic scale-down. Automatic scale-up with load is only implied by 'Serverless' and generic horizontal-scaling claims; horizontal scaling alone is not automatic autoscaling. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic compute scale-up under load, evidence of no manual resizes or downtime during scaling events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, compute autoscales up and down with load automatically, without manual resizes or downtime

citations.quote: Request Unit consumption scales to zero when your cluster has no activity.
